title: Minimal Leather armor (Intended for hoffen's minimal armor)
description: This resource pack retextures the leather armor texture to make it fit in line with the minimal armor textures in Hoffen's minimal armor.
body:
This resource pack retextures leather armor to get int the way less and let you see the player underneath. I designed this pack to fit with Hoffen's minimal armor https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/hoffens-minimal-armor

it also supports dyes.
